notes.title: Update #5: Third person view, snipers, new weapons, and more!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149788/aa2bc60190da56b9ac696cb03c134f29be952743.png

Hello, everyone!

First of all, we want to say thank you to everyone who took part in the beta testing of the new Aim Hero update! With your help the new update will have fewer errors :) 

Update # 5 is already available for everyone! 

What's new? 
[olist]
Added the ability to turn on the third-person view! The V button by default.
Added new weapons: sniper rifle, machine gun, projectile gun. (1-2-3-4 numeric buttons on keyboard)
Updated the appearance of the pistol, the lightning gun. Added animations. 
Added the ability to walk and run through the levels. On older levels, the zone for moving is not large, but in the future all new levels will be built taking into the account the new moving system. 
Added the ability to create your own preset settings for each training mode. Separate statistics are kept for each of them in the statistics section. 
Enhanced and improved crosshair settings. 
Added two new training modes: Sniper Training and Time Trial. 
Added the ability to aim through the weapon’s sight when you right-click. 
Added the ability to increase targets’ health. Use this option if you want your targets to take several hits before destruction. 
Added a new map to the Simple Training mode. 
Added support for new games: PUBG, Fortnite, Rainbow Six Siege, Quake Champions. 
Added a special section in the options for more accurate calibration of each weapon. 
Added a special section in the options for remapping keys. 
Various small tweaks and improvements. 
Some fixes. 
[/olist]

Please continue to post your bug reports in the «Bugs or Glitches» of the Community Hub. 

Thank you for staying with us!

notes.title: Update #5 Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We know you have been waiting for this update, so we apologize for keeping you waiting for so long. Our team has grown significantly, and it took us some time to solve the problems related to it. Nevertheless, we have created a wonderful team, and now we are concentrated on developing new content for Aim Hero. 

The new update is ready. It is at the stage of internal testing and will be available soon. We would like to tell you about all the details of the upcoming update in this announcement. 

Third Person View
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149788/ab44de7b9309ea11784c905c26bb9b5fc02cab2b.gif
Now you can train using the third person view mode! This option is available in any mode and applied to any map. We have also added a movement setting. 

New Weapons with Animation
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149788/5f9abb9973446b9d3c040a32e3b9ed48460f0f33.gif
Our 3D artists have completely remodeled all the weapons in Aim Hero. We have replaced and animated all of them. We hope you like the new arsenal! 

Sniper Mode
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149788/7dac02443b80e49377555573b97e5c43e82e5a83.gif
You have been waiting for it, and we have finally done it! Now there is a full sniper training.

Projectile Mode
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149788/c73106342c6783f7f7e174f8d0d7aa30a2cc8117.gif
New training mode for the weapons with non-instant bullets. You will also be able to adjust the speed and trajectory of projectiles.

Presets
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149788/0198a135ce51956e83497a9b55d6c71911723719.png
We have altered the setting of difficulty level for each training. Now you can create and use multiple difficulty presets. You can also name them and check statistics on each one in Statistics. 

Automatic Rifle
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149788/087156f3c920646c797f201c9576bb26c3c4a8ef.gif
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149788/96bc3a8e0e2ac9f2ef8e4d17950a4232c2ab810c.gif
With this update, you will get an automatic firing option. Right clicking will let to you to enable aiming option using an aim on the weapon you chose.

Crosshair Customization
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149788/e48d0df392c3f131f75b2e25ac17419e54ff6d2c.gif
You will be able to adjust your crosshair more precisely. We are going to customize and improve this setting in further updates.   

At the Top of That
All listed above are the most important details about the upcoming update. Nevertheless, this is not the full list of what we have already done. We have been adding new popular games to the list of the games that you can use for importing mouse sensitivity settings. 

Moreover, we have added:

    HP setting for your aims;
    New maps;
    One more training mode;
    A lot of other small, but useful options.
 
We have been following your requests on Aim Hero Community Hub. We have also added many of the features about which you had asked. The full list of them will be available in an article that we will publish after the release. It will not take long.

Thank you for staying with us!

notes.title: Update #4 New maps, stats, localization, and other improvements
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149788/765c85cef3023932162399dd60cf8b6c09409752.png

Hello, everyone! First of all we are sorry for the delay with the fourth update.

We know many of you are waiting for new training modes, especially the one for snipers. We have been working on the modes for a long time. Nevertheless we still believe they need some more improvements to be released. To decrease delay the new update of the game we made a decision to add the features that are currently finished.

We will add the new training modes in the next update. It will be soon.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149788/23dc4935d16a713542656add43d846a54fe54c95.png

What is new?
[olist]
Two new maps in Classic, Reflex, and Fast Aiming modes. We have enlarged the screen with appearing targets. The new maps are more efficient. 
Translations into Chinese, Korean, Russian, and Japanese languages. We are planning to extend the list. 
We have changed the rules in Reflex training mode. Now points will be added not only for hitting the targets. They will also be added for an accurate shot that did not hit a target. In this case a player gets much less points, and their number is related to the distance between the target and a spot the player hit. It makes the training with new maps on the bigger screen easier. 
Statistics is added to the main menu. This is an early version of this menu section. You can access a chart with the results of your recent trainings as well as general statistics on each training mode. 
Recoil feature is added. To activate it increase the Recoil setting in Crosshair Settings that you can find in Options menu.
Increased maximum value mouse and gamepad sensitivity setting.  
FOV floating point setting is added.
Some fixes.
[/olist]

Please continue to post your bug reports in the «Bugs or Glitches» of the Community Hub.

Thank you for staying with us!

notes.title: Update #3 – Difficulty Settings, new UI, Gamepad Support, etc.
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26149788/d4c2c37bcc4987cbbe0c98695c3a3033aa8b6a07.png

Hello, everyone! 

To date we added the feature that allows you to change the difficulty of each mode! Now you can set a time limit, targets speed and size, and change other settings. The settings are available in the Custom difficulty of the Training Mode Menu. 

We had to renew the user interface (UI) completely. The new UI is more efficient in terms of fitting in more screen elements on each page. We hope you are going to like it.   

Aim Hero now supports Gamepad! It could be useful for the console players. The feature is still in the testing mode. Please, leave your feedback on it on a specific thread on our forum: http://steamcommunity.com/app/518030/discussions/0/133256240738984278/

The full list of the improvements in this update:
[olist]
Custom difficulty settings
New UI
Gamepad Support + Gamepad settings
A new feature in Game Settings lets you to change the walls and targets color
A new feature in Video Settings lets you to turn VSync on
A new feature in Video Settings lets you to set FPS limit
A new feature in Mouse Settings lets you to turn mouse inversion on
We have also added a feature that lets you to change FOV since we had your requests to do so. This is an experimental option. The FOV values may be different from the other games.
Some fixes.
[/olist]

Please continue to post your bug reports in the Bugs or Glitches of the Community Hub.

Thank you for staying with us!

notes.title: Update #2 - a new training mode, 3D weapons, Paladins’ support, etc..
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! We are sorry for not releasing updates for a long time. We were working on solving the inner issues that did not let us to move forward. In the future, we are going to release new updates regularly. 

To date we have added a new training mode, Lighting Gun (LG), to the game. The mode is perfect for practicing the skill of aiming a target continuously. We have also added 3D weapons, the support of mouse sensitivity settings from Paladins, and other small improvements listed below.
 
What’s new?

The new training mode (LG)
3D weapons
Support of a mouse sensitivity settings from Paladins
The game options are available during the game
A window with settings, that popped up before the game started, is taken away
All the video settings are now available on a separate page in Settings. We will add new settings to the further updates
A new section, Game Settings, is added to Settings
Turn off image of a weapon option is added
Turn off a target destroying visual effect option is added
Crosshair color change option is added
Little interface improvements are done
The old bugs are fixed


A little reminder – you can use your mouse settings from any game even if it is not supported by Aim Hero yet. You can simply use the calculator: http://www.mouse-sensitivity.com/

Thank you for staying with us!
